end.parentNote: Today Atharv practised observing features such as beaks and feet, then linking those features to how birds eat or move. Some food-and-feature links were right, but the reasoning was not steady yet; a why or new-situation question still needs checking next time. At home, ask Atharv to look at two birds or pictures and say, “What feature do you notice, and how might it help?”
